audit.why: Both layers already read Trundle / Trundle / Skill / Skill / Trundle / Skill / Skill, which matches packet.levelChart exactly and matches the mirror audit's stated chart ('Trundle at levels 1, 2 and 6; Skill at level 3, levels 4-5, first item and two-plus items'). The packet's 'chart contradicts data' defect is stale — no row disagrees with its why, so nothing was flipped.

audit.whatIsWrong: Subjugate was described only as 'steals your stats' with no cooldown and no duration, so the reader has no idea when the window opens or closes.
audit.why: Kit: Subjugate (R) 120/100/80s, 650 range — 'immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount... is doubled.' Chomp (Q) 3.5s, 300 range. Frozen Domain (W) 18/17/16/15/14s, 750 range. Pillar of Ice (E) 21/19.5/18/16.5/15s, 1000 range.
audit.corrected: 120s at rank 1 plus the 4-second doubling written into the cooldown block, the Do's, the report and the level-6 spike — the practical rule is that the first seconds of the fight are yours and the rest is his.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three problems. (1) The page tells you to 'bait Chomp' — it is a 3.5-second auto reset, so it is never baited out; it comes back inside a single trade. (2) wants.foe[0] claims Chomp true-damages you; Riot's text has no true damage, it saps Attack Damage and briefly slows. (3) Frozen Domain was described as his sustain, but what it actually does is grant attack speed, move speed and INCREASED HEALING FROM ALL SOURCES while he stands on it — that is why anti-heal and fighting off the ice both matter, and neither reason was given.
audit.why: Riot text — Q: 'bites his opponent, dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage.' W: 'gaining Attack Speed, Move Speed, and increased healing from all sources while on it.' E: 'becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.'
audit.corrected: Chomp restated as an unbaitable 3.5s auto reset, the true-damage claim removed, Frozen Domain's healing amplification named, and Pillar of Ice stated as real terrain that blocks your dash out.

edits.before: - Trundle Subjugate: matchup-defining — Steals your stats. Burst before it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Subjugate: 120s at rank 1 — the steal doubles over 4 seconds, so leave before it finishes. - Chomp: 3.5s, so you cannot bait it out. - Pillar of Ice: 21s, and it is real terrain that blocks your dash.

edits.after: The steal doubles over 4 seconds — win early in the fight or leave.

edits.before: Trundle wastes Subjugate — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Chomp is 3.5s and resets his auto — expect it every trade.

edits.before: Track Trundle's Subjugate: Steals your stats. Burst before it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.

edits.before: Trundle's Chomp (Q) empowers his next hit for bonus damage and steals your AD, so trading raw autos into him bleeds you twice. Bait the Q on minions or space so your Crushing Blow (Q) lands the tail end of an all-in rather than the opener.
edits.after: Trundle's Chomp (Q) is 3.5s, resets his auto and saps your AD, so you cannot bait it out — every auto exchange bleeds you twice. Keep trades to one rotation and land Crushing Blow at the tail of an all-in, not the opener.

edits.before: Subjugate (R) is the fight-flipper: he drains a huge chunk of your resists and health, turning your bruiser stats against you. Save Cyclone (R) to peel away or knock him out of tempo, and don't R-in blind while his ult is up.
edits.after: Subjugate (R) is 120s at rank 1 and the fight-flipper: it steals your health and resists, then doubles that steal over 4 seconds. Save Cyclone (R) to knock him off you and leave — a long brawl after his ult is his.

edits.before: Land Chomp on you to steal AD and true-damage you
edits.after: Land Chomp every 3.5s to sap your attack damage

notes: The packet's defect 'chart contradicts data: Wukong wins 55.8% but the chart gives Trundle 3/7 stages vs 0' does NOT hold — the chart gives Trundle 3 and Skill 4, which is consistent with a narrow Wukong win rate, and both the packet chart and the mirror audit agree with what is already stored. I left it alone rather than manufacture flips. The mirror cites Subjugate as 40%; that percentage is not in Riot's description, so I described the doubling instead of quoting a number I cannot verify. King's Tribute heals him off nearby dying minions, which is a second reason his lane sustain is high — I did not add it because no writable field had room inside the band.
